T-058 is still blocked: the T-056 list import and the team's own LinkedIn connections are the only things left, and Bhaskar now owns both. I started no campaign and messaged no prospect.

1. **First line in the launch kit:** done. The old `{first_line}` line had already been replaced with `{{custom.first_line}}`. This run I added the result of the T-059 simulator test: 3 contacts were imported, each carried `customFields.first_line`, and each sent step showed that contact's own line.
2. **Nothing asked of Adi:** done. The ask now goes only to Bhaskar and Bharath, says outright that nothing is asked of Adi, and leaves the list import on T-056.
3. **Buy nothing, wave 1 fits the 2 existing slots:** done. The kit already said this. The connect guide had no "a slot gets added" wording, so I edited its slot line instead: anyone outside wave 1, or who hits a slot message, now joins wave 2.
4. **Team-only note to Bhaskar and Bharath:** posted on T-058. It asks Bharath whether the team workspace can get more LinkedIn slots at no charge.
5. **Assignee Bhaskar, still blocked on T-056 and the member connects:** done.
6. **Publish:** the board reads its task list (`tasks.json`) locally, so the note is already there. A previous run of this task found the GitHub Pages mirror carries no outreach docs, so I did not republish it. I did not re-check that this run.
7. **The three done_when items** (profiles connected, first campaign running within the caps, registrations on the referral dashboard): all still waiting on the T-056 import and on each member connecting their own profile.

Both doc edits are committed (not pushed) and contain no long dashes. The feedback note F-d903eaed is acknowledged. To review, open `workshop-plan/outreach/launch-kit.md` (sections 3a and 3b) and `workshop-plan/outreach/connect-linkedin-guide.md`.
